cases.name: 初始状态显示黑棋落子
点击棋盘中心落子后切换到白棋

steps.code: (() => { const c = document.getElementById('board'); const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); const click = (row,col) => c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, clientX: r.left+30+col*40, clientY: r.top+30+row*40 })); click(7,7); return 'clicked 7,7'; })()

(() => { const c = document.getElementById('board'); const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); const click = (row,col) => c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, clientX: r.left+30+col*40, clientY: r.top+30+row*40 })); click(7,7); click(8,7); click(7,8); click(8,8); click(7,9); click(8,9); click(7,10); click(8,10); click(7,11); return 'placed 9 pieces'; })()
